\- Contract: 0x821207f44209be7556fe30643a1eed4ba6e6ce52
\- Token ID: 1 (the minted token to 0x3b55868Dd2ebA28f97b3dB55a4cB706a078154B5)

You can verify the asset is live:
\- Metadata: <https://api.projectrebuild.xyz/metadata/1>
\- Image: <https://api.projectrebuild.xyz/images/1.png>
\- PDF: <https://api.projectrebuild.xyz/pdf/1>

If you still don’t see it:
1) Confirm you’re on Base network.
2) Use the NFT import flow (not token import).
3) Manually enter contract + token ID.
4) Refresh/force-reload the wallet’s NFT view.

\- token #1 exists and is owned by 0x3b55868Dd2ebA28f97b3dB55a4cB706a078154B5. Metadata and assets resolve:
\- Metadata: <https://api.projectrebuild.xyz/metadata/1>
\- Image: <https://api.projectrebuild.xyz/images/1.png>
